measurementRules.rule: Measure first-accepted whole-liquid net mass using calibrated scales/mass meters or traceable tank conversion; exclude tare and retain measured water/impurities; never reduce to pure-DMAC equivalent.

Apply the complete Section5 convention; GC-minus-water is a percentage-point subtraction only on the same basis with actual applicable methods; no additional dry-fraction multiplier or change of whole-liquid reference mass.
Retain steam and returned-condensate mass and enthalpy; retain delivered kWh, converting once by1kWh=3.6MJ if needed. Steam enthalpy is not another imported heat flow.

measurementRules.rule: Volume-to-mass conversion requires measured temperature/pressure, wet/dry basis, composition and compatible density; do not add a whole mixture and its components as duplicate amounts.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum(m_first,e) over unique first-accepted whole-product events, Q>0. a_j = A_j,new / Q; A_j,new is the evidenced attributed exchange or separate environmental-service vector, never replacement of full physical records. Old-cohort a_j,old=A_j,old/Q0; without positive known Q retain raw totals only.
calculationRules.output: Amounts per reference flow and independent full physical ledger

calculationRules.rule: Independently check Q = D_net + S_accepted + L + X using disjoint externally retained net delivery, every on-site accepted state, irreversible loss and other terminal dispositions on original acceptance basis. Gross loops do not increase Q; lost water is not restored to survivors and counted again.

For each stage reconcile opening physical stock + external receipts + actual formation = closing stock + external exports + actual consumption, cancelling paired internal transfers. Inherit own foreground WIP burdens once by genealogy; never add provider aggregate demand to its already expanded same-boundary inventory.
calculationRules.output: Physical residuals and distinct inherited vectors

calculationRules.rule: CH3COOH+(CH3)2NH→CH3CON(CH3)2+H2O identifies only the principal reaction; use actual extents and side reactions, no default conversion. Reconcile total mass, C/H/N/O, iron, liquid/vapour water and energy separately; reacting species are not individually conserved and no balancing plug is invented.
calculationRules.output: Separate material, elemental, water and energy residuals

calculationRules.rule: Record each actual receiver whole wet waste event once, with substrate/liquor/solids/water as nested components. The sum of non-overlapping treatment-service demand by original cohort equals actual receiver/provider demand; allocation does not reduce actual exports or charge a full event to every cohort.
calculationRules.output: Whole physical transfers and separate cohort treatment vectors

calculationRules.rule: Full unused/in-service opening + new receipts = closing + actual removals + evidenced dissolution/consumption. Retain actual dimensions, material and history; assign environmental service by measured original-cohort use, without assumed lifetime, item mass or duplicate manufacturing demand.
calculationRules.output: Complete physical fleet and separate environmental service

measurementRules.rule: 用校准秤、质量流量计或有据罐量换算测量首次验收整液净质量；排除皮重，保留实测水分和杂质，不按纯DMAC当量缩减。
采用第5节完整方法约定；GC减水分仅在相同基准和真实适用方法下作百分点相减，不额外乘干物率，不改变整液参考质量。
蒸汽及回水各保留质量和焓；受入电量保留kWh，需转MJ时按1kWh=3.6MJ，仅换算一次。外购蒸汽的焓不得另加为进口热流。

measurementRules.applies_to: dimethylamine; nitrogen; dmac_air; dma_air; acid_air; nma_air; water_air; nitrogen_air
measurementRules.rule: 体积到质量换算须实测温压、干湿基、组成和相容密度；整股混合物及其组分不同时加量。

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum(m_first,e)，仅合计唯一首次验收整产品事件，Q>0。a_j = A_j,new / Q；A_j,new为有据归属交换或独立环境服务向量，不覆盖整份实物记录。旧队列a_j,old=A_j,old/Q0；无正的已知Q时只保留原始总量。
calculationRules.output: 各参考量及独立完整实物账

calculationRules.rule: 独立核对Q = D_net + S_accepted + L + X；按原验收基准分别划分净外部持有交付、所有现场验收状态、不可逆损失和其他终结处置。毛循环不增加Q；失水不复原存续量再加损失。
逐阶段核对期初实物+外部收货+真实生成=期末实物+外部移出+真实消耗，内部转移成对抵消。自身前景在制品负荷按谱系继承一次；供方汇总需求与同边界展开清单不重复。
calculationRules.output: 实物残差和另列继承向量

calculationRules.rule: CH3COOH+(CH3)2NH→CH3CON(CH3)2+H2O仅给主反应身份；按实际反应进度和旁反应核对，不设默认转化率。分别核对总质量、C/H/N/O、铁、液态和气态水、能量；不得令各反应物种不变守恒或虚构补差。
calculationRules.output: 独立物料、元素、水和能量残差

calculationRules.rule: 每个实物废物事件记录接收方整份湿质量一次；基材、留液、固体、水只作嵌套组成。各原队列不重叠处理服务需求之和=实际接收方供方需求；分配份额不缩减实际外运，不向每个队列重复收取整事件。
calculationRules.output: 完整实物转移及独立队列处理向量

calculationRules.rule: 完整未用和在役期初+新收货=期末+实际移出+有据溶解或消耗。保留真实尺寸、材料和历史；环境服务按实测使用归属原队列，不假定寿命、单件质量或重复制造需求。
calculationRules.output: 完整实物库存和独立环境服务
